sharedProposal.status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Five complete mechanical proposals and ten authored examples await actual GPT discussion and exact review. Planar Binding (Minor) remains a literal post-push receipt. NEW identifies proposed design, not recovered authority or an adopted rule.
sharedProposal.casting: All five retain Action, 60 feet and base13RP. Divination access remains Cleric/Wizard11 and Mirrorsage/Shaman16; Chrono Lock additionally retains Bard16 and Mage11 Universal access. Use the actual acquired class grant, current repertoire, casting ability, components and cadence. V/S/F applies except Eye of Judgement V/S/M-or-F, with its unpriced focus alternative and no invented consumed component. DC=8+actual PB+actual source ability. Pay legal costs, concentration transition and cast-start hooks before Counterspell/hidden resolution. Countering, a save or a blocked reading refunds nothing. No automatic upcast, additional source access or borrowed Oracle RP is supplied.
sharedProposal.identityAndTime: One application retains its exact caster, recipient, school/rank, components, admission history and original endpoint. The two explicit one-round procedures below use target first future regular END, excluding an in-progress target turn; this is an explicit unified choice also for willing recipients. Preserve that virtual marker through absence/initiative changes, with end events before expiry cleanup. Outside initiative use application+6seconds and retain that deadline on entry. Extra turns never advance these clocks. Elapsed maxima start at resolution; suppression never resets them or banks missed events. No temporal rewind or full Time Loop implementation is claimed.
sharedProposal.information: Actual established hidden but unprotected facts are legitimate information within each spell's stated scope. Missing facts are not invented. Apply real information defenses to the actual subject, field, generating school/rank and event. A field-specific block does not erase unrelated readable information. Indeterminate does not identify the hidden cause; actual defenses that specify a different non-actionable result retain it. Equivalent inquiries under materially unchanged facts share a stable answer across wording/casters; materially different relevant facts or questions can support a new paid inquiry. No extra RP, Reaction, command, consent, credential or future choice follows from learning an answer.
sharedProposal.sourcesAndLimits: Reviewed ordinary control, life, capacity, body/equipment, resource and EX58 work/rest rules remain governing. Suppression is not deletion, payment reversal, restoration, ordinary rest or a new effect-creation event. Shared hard-control history remains source-character/target/encounter, not spell-name-specific. Source-defined immunity can prevent a component; a generic spell title supplies no immunity or classification. Actual faction identity/standing remains distinct from membership and authority. Comparison proposals are full retained drafts, not approvals.
sharedProposal.examples: Unless stated otherwise, eligible Wizard11 has INT+4, PB+4, DC16, spell attack+8, RP40/40, Dissonance0 and limit10. A fresh rank-six cast costs13 and leaves27 before any other actual event. Mage11 has RP maximum32. Authored examples are table adjudications, not executed spell-runtime or human-balance tests.
sharedProposal.deferredBoundary: Planar Binding (Minor), its Divination placement, Action/60feet/Instantaneous/base13RP and printed extraplanar CR8 service clause remain unchanged. No service authority, creature origin, portal, soul, pantheon or cosmological interpretation is supplied before the authorized push and verified remote commit.

proposals.procedure:
KEEP both actual placements: Divination freezes exactly one creature in time for one round with no save; Universal grants no Actions or damage for one round. NEW harmonize them into the following full local suspension, with no save in either mode and damage protection in both. This expressly extends the Divination wording with the Universal clause; the original two entries remain distinct evidence and the selected class still determines the generating school. This is not a selectable bargain between a vulnerable and an invulnerable mode. One perceived living or otherwise active creature within60feet/line of effect, including self; an inanimate corpse or detached object is not a creature target. NEW no concentration, lasting to the target's first future regular END, or the original outside-initiative six-second endpoint. It is not ordinary Frozen, Petrified, Stunned or Incapacitated.

Apply the shared source-character/target/encounter hard-denial admission even when the recipient is willing, an explicit NEW conservation choice. Actual immunity to temporal suspension or equivalent whole-Action denial prevents admission. No save is silently introduced to replace the source's express no-save clause. A used allowance or actual protection produces no suspension or protective fallback and no delayed attempt; legal committed casting costs remain spent. Spend the allowance only on actual establishment. Neither ending nor suppression refunds that history. A target already under operative full bodily suspension cannot receive another bodily application through it; a genuinely suppressed old suspension may allow a different source's legal attempt, without extending either original endpoint.

While operative, the target is unaware and cannot speak, act, take Bonus Actions/Reactions, make voluntary choices or move. Hold its actual body and actually worn/carried inanimate gear at the current place and pose. Voluntary/forced relocation, ordinary teleportation and gravity cannot move that held body; an actual explicit source overcoming temporal suspension retains only its printed exception. Carried or mounted other creatures are not frozen by association: ordinary custody/support and separation rules determine their legal positions, and the target cannot carry them away because it cannot move. Gear cannot be detached, used or looted through the held body. Do not infer automatic STR/DEX failure, attack advantage, adjacent criticals or prone from a different condition's name.

The suspended body and its held gear receive no new damage, healing, temporaryHP, condition, directHP loss or physical alteration. Otherwise legal attempts pay their real costs and resolve no such payload; incoming damage is prevented, never accumulated for release. No resource can be paid through the body's unavailable voluntary action. Existing periodic bodily outputs due while held are skipped, not banked; death saves create neither successes nor failures. Age, immediate respiration and metabolism pause for the interval, but no food, water, completed work or rest credit is supplied. World elapsed time, actual regular markers, rest/shortage calendars, recharge history and existing effect deadlines continue. A due lethal world-track transition is recorded under its real source; suspension does not erase or defer that source's explicitly world-timed death rule. An effect that ends while held stays ended.

Existing concentration is not ended solely by this distinct non-Incapacitated state. Its ordinary expiry, actual unpaid voluntary upkeep, dependent source ending or genuine independent concentration-ending rule still applies. Already independent external spell fields, completed projectiles and other bodies keep their own legal behavior and do not become frozen. NEW body-emitted class/spell aura output and voluntary command/control operation are unavailable while the source body is held; the underlying source clock continues, and missed outputs/orders do not replay. A pending paid activation requiring further personal action cannot complete that requirement; a fully committed independent effect may still resolve under its own actual dependency rules. No cost is refunded.

The Chrono Lock application itself remains reachable for actual eligible rank-six dispel, suppression or specific removal, despite the body's payload protection. NEW the originating caster may dismiss its own application without an Action during its actual turn only while able to act; a self-locked caster cannot use dismissal while suspended. Ending or suppression restores ordinary interaction at the current real location, with no backlog, free turn, fresh movement or restored Action. Only actual unspent permissions of a still-current turn remain. When suppression ceases before the original deadline, the same live application resumes around its surviving eligible creature at its then-current position; it cannot snap back to its old position or restart the round. Death/removal of that creature ends its application. Unsupported height after suspension uses the real Fall Marker; physical gear, broken support and real elapsed consequences remain. This finite state supplies no world rewind, snapshot restoration or implementation approval for the temporal kernel.
workedCases: DI6-02-A: A Wizard spends13RP, leaving27, and applies the Divination grant to one foe that has not spent this caster's hard-control allowance. There is no save. Under the proposed harmonization a sword hit and a poison damage tick while held produce no bodily damage and no stored burst; both original effect clocks continue. The target's first future regular turn occurs without Actions and the Lock expires after that turn's end events. It grants no second turn on release.

DI6-02-B: The same caster cannot renew the Lock against that target this encounter, even if the target now consents. A separate eligible application interrupted by temporary suppression keeps its original deadline: real damage and movement may occur during the gap, then surviving-body suspension resumes at the new position. It neither heals those wounds nor recovers a spent Reaction; an ordinary dispel still needs its actual rank-six eligibility/check.
proposals.newChoices: NEW shared no-save/no-damage suspension for both schools, nonconcentration target-next-end clock, willing-recipient hard-control admission, full body/gear boundary and explicit suppression/return procedure.

proposals.procedure:
KEEP Action,60feet,V/S/M-or-F,one creature,WIS resisting,and revealing and suppressing class features for one round. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect; no willingness/type/class-level exclusion is added. Make one WIS save against the original casting DC before changing any defensive feature. Success negates both revelation and suppression. Failure establishes the independently scoped reading and class-feature suppression below until the target's first future regular END, or the original six-second outside endpoint; no concentration and no repeat save. Classless creatures can be targeted, but no class features are manufactured for them.

READING: on the initial failed save, privately show the caster the actual currently acquired class-feature identities and their complete operative mechanical descriptions, including applicable Base/Arch/Hero/Mystery/Oath selections and genuine passive/active modes. Reveal these as current class mechanics, not a dump of historical source variants or every unselected future option. Current temporarily unusable but genuinely acquired features remain part of that readable roster. NEW the result is one snapshot, not a live feed; suppression/return does not rerun it. It includes the actual class identity necessary to understand a feature, but no independent exact class-level, ability-score, currentHP/RP, remaining-use ledger, prepared-spell list, inventory, oath history or private biography query. An unavoidable inference from legitimately revealed mechanics is ordinary inference. A genuinely established empty class-feature roster can return No Class Features; missing/unclassified records return Indeterminate for that portion instead of inventing an NPC class.

Apply information defenses as they stood for this initial application before suppression. A blocked or contradictory reading is not retried after its defensive feature is suppressed. Protection against information alone need not prevent the separately operative suppression; a defense against the whole actual spell does. Oracle's Burden and the selected intrinsic Oracle Curse retain their actual expressly protected status: this generic class suppression does not strip the Burden to bootstrap suppression of the Curse or its protected effects. In particular, preserve an acquired Soul-Cracked Boon IV's actual direct-divination d2 information result and its real scope; do not invent a random false class sheet. This is not a new exception authorizing a Curse cure.

SUPPRESSION: disable actual active, passive, triggered and activated mechanics whose continuing source is the target's acquired class feature, including actual Base/Arch/Hero abilities, class engines and their real aliases. This covers class Extra Attack, class-casting/command/recovery permissions, class AC/Speed/damage modifiers and continuous class bonuses delivered to real dependents. Resolve aliases as one source, not a surviving second copy. Do not remove earned levels, the ordinary level-derived PB/baseHP/base resource schedule, permanent acquired ability-score increases, ordinary learned skill/tool/language/weapon training, selected feats, ancestry, background, equipment powers or native NPC actions merely because those facts appear on a class sheet. A class-only expertise or proficiency multiplier is suppressed; the underlying ordinary proficiency remains. A feature genuinely supplied independently by an unaffected source remains usable only under that source's own costs and limits. Acquiring a feat through an ASI selection does not turn that feat into a class feature.

The creature retains its ordinary Action, movement and legal mundane options. This is not whole-Action loss merely because its favored attacks/spells are unavailable, and spends no hard-control allowance. It imposes no Stunned/Incapacitated or mandatory wasted Action. No permission to erase a pending entire ordinary Action is added. A previously committed class activation that still requires an unavailable feature to resolve has no suppressed payload, while its real costs stay spent; any expressly independent already-committed spell or physical projectile follows the distinction below. Hard-control components originating from genuinely suppressed class parents cannot act during the interval, but their admission history and endpoints persist; return does not claim again. Actual ordinary control spells already cast through a class casting engine are not themselves erased with that engine.

DEPENDENTS: an already established ordinary spell remains its own ongoing spell application, including actual spells generated by class cards whose operative source supplies the spell interface; losing permission for the next cast does not end an old one. Continuous class modifiers to that spell cease while their feature is suppressed. Actual feature-maintained auras, stances, form benefits, marks and periodic outputs become inoperative, with original clocks and relationship requirements continuing. A Druid class form whose anatomy is actively feature-maintained reverts through the reviewed one-body/equipment procedure during suppression; its still-live original form may resume only if its real duration, concentration, custody and geometry remain legal. No new creation, fullHP body, fresh gear state or re-paid activation is invented. An instantaneous permanent bodily change or completed ordinary material/output is not rolled back.

Existing class-created companion/device bodies and actual items remain present with their real identity, inventory, currentHP, source slots and ending rules; creation is not repeated on return. The suppressed owner's class command permission cannot issue new commands or execute a pending command dependent on it. Capable uncommanded companions retain their real defensive Move/Dodge procedure and attached phase; independent creatures retain actual native agency, without an extra turn. Ordinary spell-granted command permission independent of a suppressed class-only feature remains only if its source expressly supplies it. Ownership, slot reservations, no-duplicate-body histories and shared one-command/one-offense accounting persist. Passive owner-class maximumHP bonuses on dependent creatures are suppressed even if that dependent is elsewhere; it is the feature's continuing output, not a new ranged target or secret roster report.

CAPACITY/ECONOMY: remove suppressible class maximumHP modifiers and recompute using the reviewed separate-record formula; clamp current normalHP downward if necessary, without damage, Wounds, first-fall triggers or concentration checks. Returning capacity gives no HP. Base level-derived resource capacity/identity remains, but a separately suppressible capacity bonus is unavailable. NEW conservation partition for an existing finite resource balance above its temporary operative cap: keep the excess in that same pool's inaccessible reserve, not a second spendable pool. Only the accessible part can be spent by a genuinely independent remaining permission. Gains/refunds must account for both portions against the operative cap, never refill space occupied by reserved units. As capacity actually returns, move still-existing reserved units back only up to that capacity; do not generate new units. If a real source-specific permanent loss removes those units, the reserve cannot restore them. All spending, daily/recharge/recovery/cooldown histories and debt remain. Source-defined cooldown progression continues even when activation is unavailable; missed class-triggered recoveries or pulses are lost, not queued. A feature return is neither a rest nor encounter start. Obligations and already incurred costs are not canceled by suppressing their source.

Ending, actual dispel or suppression of Eye restores only still-present eligible mechanics. It does not reconstruct ended concentration/forms, removed companions, spent entitlements, expired marks or completed lost triggers. Repeated Eye applications are independent same-effect suppression records, no additive penalty; a surviving one keeps its coverage when another ends. An information result already received can be remembered normally and is not erased by later dispel. No class acquisition/retraining, alignment judgment, oathbreaking finding or cosmological authority is supplied. The proposed general feature/dependency and resource-partition interfaces require explicit joint review; existing isolated class helpers do not establish runtime support.
workedCases: DI6-03-A: A target with base maximumHP60 and an actually acquired operative+20 class capacity feature is at75/80HP. After failed WIS, suppressing that feature yields maximum60 and clamps HP to60 without damage or a Wound. When Eye ends, maximum80 returns but HP remains60. A separately acquired feat bonus, ordinary skill training and an already cast independent spell were not deleted; the caster receives no automatic current-resource ledger.

DI6-03-B: A finite pool holds12 units under an actual extra-capacity class bonus. Its temporary operative cap becomes10:10 are accessible and2 reserved in the same conserved balance. If an independent legal source spends3 accessible units,7 accessible+2 reserved remain. Capacity restoration returns9 total, not12 or a refilled maximum. An information defense active at the initial reading is resolved then; suppressing an ordinary defensive feature later does not reroll the reading or bypass Oracle's protected Curse.
proposals.newChoices: NEW exact class-feature information/suppression boundary across all17 classes, preserved Oracle intrinsic protection, separate class parents and independent spells, non-healing capacity clamp and conserved inaccessible resource excess.

proposals.procedure:
KEEP Action,60feet,V/S/F,instantaneous and the shortest route to a specific location. NEW one willing perceived creature within60feet/line of effect, including self, receives a private route from its actual current location. Before commitment identify one fixed specific place actually known to caster or recipient by prior visit or a genuine sufficiently precise established description/map. An arbitrary category such as nearest treasure, whoever stole my sword, a moving person's present hiding place or a guessed unknown door is not a specific known location. Ordinary known invalid declarations can be rejected; hidden misidentification, an inaccurate genuine reference, absent route and protected facts resolve after legal payment and return Indeterminate without diagnostic refunds.

Destination distance is not limited to60feet: that range belongs to the recipient. NEW this mechanical route is restricted to actual currently connected physical geography on the recipient's existing plane, with no invented cross-plane topology or use of portals/teleports. The destination may be remote and its connecting map concealed. The spell can reveal a real hidden passage needed by the route, so ordinary lack of map knowledge does not itself bar a result. It does not generate missing world geometry: the Director must have actual established destination/topology facts, including a privately established map or concrete scene description, sufficient to support the answer. Partial reliable information may be stated as such; no complete route is asserted through a genuinely undefined segment.

SHORTEST means least total actual centerline travel distance among currently physically traversable continuous itineraries for that recipient's actual body and available locomotion, with legal whole-body clearance and load. Use the same current distance/diagonal/topology convention as ordinary travel; measure slopes, climbs and swims by actual path length. Do not optimize safety, speed, number of checks, toll cost or encounter count. A shorter dangerous climb can beat a longer level corridor if the real recipient has the ordinary ability to attempt that climb. Actual required movement checks are conditional permissions, not predicted successes. A route cannot rely on a movement mode the recipient lacks, a transformation/spell not yet activated, a future tool it does not possess, an unsupported body gap, phasing through solid walls, destroying structural barriers or magically creating a passage. Existing time-limited locomotion can support a segment only where its present real remaining duration and the actual travel/work timing permit reaching and completing that segment; do not renew it for the answer.

An actual openable closed door or real climb/swim obstacle can be a traversable segment. A locked door may qualify only when a real current ordinary method available to that recipient permits an attempt to open it under the door's actual rules; the directions still require that attempt, its genuine Action/work and tool/DC permissions. No key, lock-code, success result, destructive breaching permission, consent or credential is granted. An actually impassable seal without an available opening method excludes that segment. Required checks, legal openings and available traversal methods are considered when deciding possible passage, but no future dice are rolled or compelled. Another creature's willingness is not assumed. The individual's route says nothing about whether companions, a wagon or the full expedition roster fit; a party chooses actual movement/capacity and time under EX58.

Give one complete compact itinerary: ordered turns/junctions, headings and distances, required current locomotion changes and recognizable route-specific landmarks or opening points. It can specify the location of a concealed entrance it actually uses; no unrelated room inventory, traps, inhabitants, map branches, exact hidden lock DCs, secret passwords or safe timing is supplied. An actual information protection that blocks an indispensable route segment makes that portion unavailable; do not silently return a longer route as the shortest. If multiple equal-length routes exist, choose once by a stable neutral map order for those premises, not by hidden danger or caster preference after the answer. The instantaneous itinerary is a snapshot, not a moving beacon, continual recalculation, perfect-memory feature or ongoing spell that can be dispelled from memory. Writing/sharing it takes ordinary means and time.

Later closures, floods, movement loss, failed checks or changed access can make the itinerary unusable. Ordinary inference may reveal that, but the spell sends no update and consumes no new costs automatically. A new materially changed route question needs another legal paid cast. Equivalent inquiries under unchanged premises return the same route, not alternate branches useful for enumerating the entire hidden map. NEW all no-route, undefined-route, hidden-reference and protected-route results use Indeterminate rather than a diagnostic classification; a completely known unreachable route can of course be recognized by ordinary knowledge. The spell does not move anyone, complete travel, grant extra Watches, repair navigation tools or bypass a forbidden cosmology branch.
workedCases: DI6-04-A: A willing explorer receives directions toward a known fixed hall. The established map has an80-foot route using an actual climb the explorer can attempt and a120-foot level corridor. The spell names the80-foot route despite its risk, with the real climb checkpoint. It does not promise the climb roll or certify that a loaded wagon fits. No magical short cut through the intervening wall is created.

DI6-04-B: The shortest established route uses a real locked door for which the recipient has an actually permitted opening method. Directions identify that door but supply neither its hidden password nor a successful check. If the door is later sealed beyond that method, the remembered itinerary does not update. A new paid inquiry can use the changed topology; a protected indispensable route segment instead yields an incomplete/Indeterminate result, not an unlabelled claim that a longer path is shortest.
proposals.newChoices: NEW local willing recipient, remote fixed known destination, actual shortest-distance feasible route with conditional traversal checks, complete stable snapshot and nondiagnostic hidden failure.

proposals.procedure:
KEEP Action,60feet,V/S/F,instantaneous and possible futures for a faction based on its current actions. NEW choose one willing perceived recipient within60feet/line of effect, including self, plus one exact known canonical factionId and one concrete institutional question about the consequences of its actual current activity. The range belongs to the recipient, not an invented local headquarters radius. No representative, membership, favorable standing or authority over the faction is required. The spell does not create a faction/subfaction to make a guessed grouping eligible; a valid institution can be distant without establishing any new planar navigation or cosmology.

NEW horizon30 elapsed days from resolution, with up to three materially distinct supported possible futures for that one question. Each scenario contains a short institutional outcome and at most three chronological milestones within the horizon, with time windows no finer than one day, plus one stated material branch condition explaining how this future differs. A branch condition must concern the consequences of actual current actions, commitments or pressures: continuation, a genuinely plausible failure, interruption or a decision already at issue. The caster cannot use this as a general answer engine for three unrelated hypothetical new plans. The Director selects the most material alternatives under established facts and records that selection neutrally when several are coequal; do not manufacture an unsupported third future to fill a quota.

Use genuine current plans, actual capacities, relationships, pressures and individual choices where relevant. Hidden unprotected premises can support the institutional prediction without becoming a separate private dossier. The current most-supported scenario may be called likely; genuinely plausible alternatives may be labelled conditional. Do not invent numerical probabilities, roll future dice, guarantee a result or force a player/NPC to choose it. Uncertainty/free will alone does not withhold otherwise supportable useful forecasts. A required undefined/protected premise yields Indeterminate for the affected milestone/scenario; a genuinely established expectation of no responsive material change may be reported as such. Give independently meaningful readable portions without identifying a hidden ward or absent data field as the reason for a gap.

The returned branch condition can reveal a concrete unprotected institutional risk essential to understanding the outcome, such as loss of a known supply route. It does not separately disclose a complete member roster, treasury, private leader memories, secret operative coordinates, exact die outcomes or every subordinate objective. An individual information ward keeps its actual scope: a protected private decision cannot be relabelled institutional truth to evade it, while independently established public or hidden unprotected institutional circumstances remain readable. Ordinary inferences from legitimately disclosed outcomes are permitted. Source-qualified protections use this actual Divination/rank-six inquiry, without a new universal defense bypass.

Equivalent questions across casters/rephrasing and trivial horizon shifts under materially unchanged circumstances repeat the same overlapping-window scenario set; no rotating coequal branches or query-driven hidden-fact enumeration. A genuinely different institutional question, actual changed premises or materially new horizon segment can support another paid inquiry without an invented daily cap. Later decisions, new events or ordinary dice may produce a fourth outcome that was not among the three most-material supported scenarios. That does not rewrite a conditional earlier answer as a binding promise. The result can be remembered/shared normally, has no ongoing monitor to dispel and never updates itself.

This remains distinct from Faction Divination's one present objective and the earlier unadopted Faction Prophecy's seven-day most-likely timeline. The longer horizon and alternative scenarios are expressly new rank-six design choices for joint review, not missing source text recovered from the book. Nothing changes standing, loyalty, leadership, faction rights, social-check results, agency or a campaign's actual future. It supplies no new cosmic fate model or authority to decide unpublished lore.
workedCases: DI6-05-A: A known faction is actually preparing to reopen a trade route. A thirty-day inquiry can show one supported future where its current convoy plan succeeds, a second where a genuinely plausible bridge loss delays it, and a third only if another material alternative is established. Each has at most three dated milestones. No future check is rolled now, and the faction is free to abandon its plan.

DI6-05-B: Rephrasing the same question tomorrow without meaningful changes repeats the same supported overlapping-window scenarios rather than exposing three more hidden leaders. An actual intervening destruction of the convoy supports a new paid forecast. A protected leader decision stays protected, but an independently established supply failure can still support a useful institutional consequence without revealing the private decision.
proposals.newChoices: NEW thirty-day horizon, up to three conditional institutional futures with bounded milestones, local recipient/remote institution and stable equivalent inquiries without compelled outcomes.

proposals.procedure:
KEEP the strong source promise to predict ALL spell effects in an area for the next minute, Action,60feet and V/S/F. SOURCE COMPLETION: Core calls this Instantaneous although the promise spans a minute. NEW propose an ongoing nonconcentration information field lasting60 elapsed seconds: a fixed20-foot-radius sphere centered at a perceived point within60feet/line of effect. The caster is its sole information recipient and must remain within60feet of that center with line of effect to it to receive an event; leaving stops reception, not the source clock. Origin-to-effect line of effect clips the readable area, so the field cannot survey effects behind solid total cover. This consciously implements advance warning of committed/pending effects, not an immutable list of all future voluntary choices. The difference requires explicit joint review; the original promise and Instantaneous field remain preserved verbatim.

On establishment, give a private forecast of ALL already established ongoing spell effects with a readable local portion that can affect this area during the next minute, including their actual still-pending scheduled occurrences. There is no numerical spell count or guessed rank ceiling: rank0 and higher actual spell sources are included, subject to actual information defenses. State their readable current local footprints and source-defined upcoming effects/timing. Where future occurrence depends on upkeep, movement, a future trigger or unresolved choice, state that actual condition rather than guarantee it. This grants no retrospective inventory of already ended casts and no new detection of dormant items, intrinsic creature traits, ordinary class engines or nonspell hazards. A class ability with an actual spell interface can qualify through that interface; calling an ability magical is insufficient.

During the window, NEW deliver a warning whenever an actual committed spell has declared an effect whose current chosen or source-defined potential footprint intersects the readable area. At ordinary cast commitment, deliver the notice after legal costs/components/choices and exact cast-start hooks commit but before the existing Counterspell window resolves. For a prepared Ready spell whose later destination was not fixed at preparation, notify its actual preparation only insofar as current declared effects can affect the area, then notify the later real release/target choice when fixed; release is not a new cast or Counterspell window. A cast committed elsewhere that later has an actual locally arriving projectile/effect produces its local notice immediately before that effect's first local resolution, not a retroactive opportunity to counter the completed cast. Actual changes to already committed choices send one update only when material local consequences change. An unchosen future spell cannot be identified before anyone commits it.

A notice contains the actual readable spell/effect identity and generating rank/school, the local area/trajectory, its declared mechanical damage/condition/creation/control categories and ordinary remaining save/attack/random resolution, plus when that committed effect is next due locally. Describe source-defined dice and conditional rider predicates; never roll them early, reveal a future face or declare hit/miss before actual resolution. A random later arc is forecast as the real potential arc procedure until its legal targets are actually fixed. Full information within this scope can warn of a hidden or silent spell, but grants no independent current location/identity of a remote caster, secret target roster, private choices not yet made, remaining resource balance or upstream provenance search. Local unprotected spell footprints can reveal an attached location by ordinary inference; that still is not actual sight of the creature and does not grant legal targeting against an unseen caster.

Actual defenses independently limit protected identity, footprint or other fields; meaningful readable parts remain, with Indeterminate for protected/undefined fields and no diagnostic of the reason. A defense that hides the existence of the whole local spell can prevent the whole notice. The field does not transform a specifically hidden effect into a public signal for everyone nearby. Recipients may communicate only through ordinary available means. Multiple identical Prophecy fields/overlapping portions use the same actual cast/application/event identity: one notice per material state to that caster, not several chances to reroll or extract different hidden answers. A separately established recipient can receive their own permitted reading, without creating extra source casts or outcomes.

No Action, Reaction, free movement, Counterspell attempt, advantage, damage prevention or RP refund is granted by a warning. A caster can spend an already available legally triggered Reaction; ordinary Counterspell still requires perception of the actual creature casting within its real range/line of effect, components, actual source access and its own payment/check. Advance knowledge of a fire area does not itself allow off-turn escape or counter an already finished cast. If another real interrupt negates the pending spell, its conditional warning remains an honest statement of what had been committed; no predicted damage is forced to occur. If a spell changes because of a genuine allowed interrupt, respect that actual change instead of compelling the earlier prediction.

Suppression blocks readings while the original60-second deadline and every observed effect's own clock continue. Lost warnings are not queued. NEW on return or reentry into the reception range, provide the currently remaining prospective schedule for still-live readable spell effects, without past results, expired warnings or another copy of already received unchanged information. The field cannot predict its own earlier creation; it may report later genuinely committed other Prophecy casts through the same finite event procedure without recursive prophecy events, since receiving information is not casting a spell. One live field per caster; a successful new cast replaces the old field with a new paid minute, never resets other effects. Expiry, actual removal or caster death ends it. The proposal supplies a useful complete warning stream within the explicit field/defense boundary; it neither claims complete temporal-runtime support nor decides future actors' agency.
workedCases: DI6-06-A: During an active field, a visible enemy within actual Counterspell range commits a fire spell aimed into the readable sphere. The caster receives its readable identity, rank, local footprint and save/damage procedure before the normal counter window, but no future die result. If the caster already has a legal Reaction and source access, they may pay for an ordinary Counterspell; the Prophecy itself grants no extra attempt or free movement.

DI6-06-B: A remote caster committed a projectile before its path entered the field. A local arrival warning can describe its impending readable effect, but cannot reopen the remote spell's old counter window or reveal that caster's current position. If Prophecy is suppressed for ten seconds, missed arrivals are not replayed; on return it reports only still-live prospective effects before the original sixty-second deadline, without changing future choices.
proposals.newChoices: NEW fixed20-foot nonconcentration one-minute field and complete eligible committed-effect warning stream, explicit Instantaneous conflict, honest random/future-choice limits and ordinary reaction/counter windows.
